**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Alaydriem/bedrock-voice-chat/compare/v1.0.0-beta.21...mods-v1.0.0-beta.23

Bedrock Voice Chat Server Beta 23

Have questions? - Review the Website: https://www.bedrockvoicechat.com - Chat about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/CdtchD5zxr - Review the Wiki: https://github.com/Alaydriem/bedrock-voice-chat/wiki ---- # Download the Mods here on Github, or from Modrinth + Curseforge | Addon Type | Download | |--------------|-------------| | Bedrock Server Addon | [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft-bedrock/addons/bedrock-voice-chat-for-realms)| | Realms/Aternos Addon | [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft-bedrock/addons/bedrock-voice-chat) | | Fabric + PaperMC | [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bedrock-voice-chat) | # Minecraft Realms, Aternos, and No-Net Server BDS Addons ## Installation See the specific installation guides for more details. - [Realms Installation Guide](https://www.bedrockvoicechat.com/wiki/platforms/realms/) - [Aternos & Other no-networking Installation Guide](https://www.bedrockvoicechat.com/wiki/platforms/aternos/) | Filename | Purpose | |-----------|----------| | bvc-bds-pack-no-net-1.0.0-beta.23.mcaddon | Install this on your Realm or Aternos or other server that doesn't support enabling `@minecraft/server-net` | | bvc-bds-pack-1.0.0-beta.23.mcaddon | Install this on your BDS server instance | ## Supported Versions It is _extremely_ important to note that the no-net mod is version sensitive. You MUST install the correct mod version to the correct Bedrock server version for the mod to work. The support matrix is listed as follows. | Mod Version | Bedrock Version | Protocol | |-------------|-----------------|----------| | 1.0.0-beta.23 | 26.50.x | v2193 | > Note that you will STILL need to run through the Bedrock Dedicated Server Installation Process for Bedrock Voice Chat Server to use BVC on Aternos and Realms. This is NOT an optional step. > Please make sure if you're upgrading between versions of the mcaddon you delete the behavior + resource pack from your global settings before re-installing ## Reporting Issues Please report any issue to either a dedicated forum post in Discord // #bvc-support, or as a detailed issue. I am specifically looking for feedback for individuals who want to test either of these features before anyone else.
